BL-1123 — Guard master checkout: never leave core.bare=true or a collapsed tip tree
What it solves: Source: .swarmforge/operator/INTAKE-master-bare-true-index-disaster-20260825.md Recovery SHAs named there (c121c8b9, 38338a74a9). Do not push e72eaffdf.
Approval context: Incident 2026-08-25: .git/config core.bare flipped to true (twice), main tip collapsed to tiny trees, ~7798 false staged adds. Coordinator restored tip and bare=false; cause of the flip still unknown (concurrent commits as author t visible). Review detector/heal scope vs identifying the writer.
BL-1123 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-1123" (or "reject BL-1123 <reason>") to act.
